conditions.correct_source: fitted source model without deployment distortion
conditions.rate_x2: all source hazards multiplied by two; ordering preserved
conditions.risk_compressed: log-risk power 0.5 around hazard 0.12; ordering preserved
conditions.risk_expanded: log-risk power 1.75 around hazard 0.12; ordering preserved
conditions.scene_swap: quiet and busy scene labels swapped before source prediction
conditions.subject_cycle: subject labels cyclically permuted before source prediction
conditions.subject_scene_permutation: subject cycle and scene swap applied together

protocol.inference: paired seed-cluster 20000-resample bootstrap and exact sign test
protocol.noise: deterministic event-status flips on calibration only; clean target test
protocol.pairing: all source variants share source training, target calibration rows, target test rows, event draws, censoring, and optimizer settings
protocol.split: outcome-independent nested target calibration and fixed group-disjoint test; both controlled gates use the same additional identity-disjoint discovery/confirmation split
protocol.target_mechanism: in-distribution target rows shared by every deployed-source variant
